upgrades.name: Additional Table & Stools
upgrades.nyahComment: More chairs means more coin... and more spilled ale I have to wipe up. Don't look at me like that, Master!
upgrades.desc: Place an additional sturdy wooden dining table and stools in the common room.

upgrades.name: Maid Hustle Drills
upgrades.nyahComment: Pick up those feet, Fifi! A slow maid is a useless maid! Balance that tray or no treats!
upgrades.desc: Pacing and balance drills that increase maid movement and service speed by 5% per rank.

upgrades.name: Kitchen Quick-Prep
upgrades.nyahComment: Faster with the skillets! Cold stew gets sent right back and I refuse to hear customer whining!
upgrades.desc: Sharpen knives and streamline cooking prep lines, boosting cooking speed by 5% per rank.

upgrades.name: Beeswax Wood Polish
upgrades.nyahComment: Rub until it shines like glass. If I catch a single grease smudge on that wood, you're re-polishing it!
upgrades.desc: Fresh beeswax buffing and lavender water spray providing a cozy ambience bonus per rank.

upgrades.name: Town Crier Pitch
upgrades.nyahComment: Slip five copper coins to that loudmouth herald by the square. Everyone in the valley should smell our stew!
upgrades.desc: Bribe town criers to shout about tavern specials, boosting customer arrival rates by 6% per rank.

upgrades.name: Sturdy Pine Furnishings
upgrades.nyahComment: Smooth planed pine with iron corner brackets. At least drunk mercenaries won't crack these in half.
upgrades.desc: Replace primitive rough-hewn benches with solid pine tables and back-supported chairs.

upgrades.name: Polished Oak Furnishings
upgrades.nyahComment: Ooh, dark stained oak! Master, if someone tries carving their stupid initials into these, I am scratching them.
upgrades.desc: Upgrade all tables to lustrous stained oak tables fitted with comfortable tufted cushions.

upgrades.name: Royal Mahogany Suites
upgrades.nyahComment: Imported mahogany and crushed crimson velvet! Even the prissiest nobles can't turn their noses up now.
upgrades.desc: Install lavish royal mahogany dining tables with gilded brass trim and velvet armchairs.

upgrades.name: Kitchen Expansion
upgrades.nyahComment: Finally! A real brick hearth and double iron stove so Fifi can stop dicing onions on the tap counter!
upgrades.desc: Knock through the rear partition to construct a fully equipped commercial kitchen wing.

upgrades.name: Adventurer Supply Counter
upgrades.nyahComment: Adventurers will literally throw gold sacks at red glass bottles and dried meat. Pure profit, Master!
upgrades.desc: Build an expedition outfitting counter selling potions, elixirs, and field rations to questing parties.

upgrades.name: Great Timber Hall
upgrades.nyahComment: Look at all this room! High timber ceiling, stone archways... we can seat whole caravans at once!
upgrades.desc: Double the main tavern floorplan with grand oak trusses, carved pillars, and expanded table capacity.

upgrades.name: Upstairs Lodging Wing
upgrades.nyahComment: Second floor traveler rooms! Weary merchants paying twenty gold pieces just to sleep off their ale.
upgrades.desc: Construct an upper floor featuring clean overnight lodging suites and private traveler beds.

upgrades.name: Goose-Down Featherbeds
upgrades.nyahComment: Replaced the scratchy straw sacks with plush goose featherbeds. Don't get comfortable, Master, you're working!
upgrades.desc: Upgrade upstairs lodging beds to cloud-soft goose-down mattresses and fine woven linen sheets.

upgrades.name: Deep Stone Wine Cellar
upgrades.nyahComment: A cool subterranean vault for aging reserve vintages. Make sure Old Barnaby stays out of the elven casks!
upgrades.desc: Excavate a cool limestone barrel cellar to age premium wines, imperial stouts, and elven nectars.

upgrades.name: Bardic Performance Stage
upgrades.nyahComment: An elevated stage with brass footlights! Now minstrels can perform without getting ale splashed over them.
upgrades.desc: Build an acoustic timber performance stage with curtained backdrop and ambient lantern footlights.

upgrades.name: Verdant Garden Terrace
upgrades.nyahComment: An open-air garden terrace with wisteria arbors and stone fountains! It is... actually beautiful, Master.
upgrades.desc: Open an outdoor flagstone garden terrace with blooming trellises, lanterns, and courtyard seating.

upgrades.name: Hire Clover (Maid)
upgrades.nyahComment: She gets flustered if a customer sneezes near her, but she sprints like lightning when panicked. She's hired.
upgrades.desc: Hire Clover, an anxious but astonishingly fast junior rabbit-folk maid to assist with service.

upgrades.name: Hire Roxie (Maid)
upgrades.nyahComment: She rolled her eyes right at me during the interview! I will break that sassy attitude, Master, just watch!
upgrades.desc: Hire Roxie, a bold tomboy maid who handles rude customers with fearless intimidation.

upgrades.name: Hire Chef Marcel (Sous-Chef)
upgrades.nyahComment: He waves his ladle around singing dramatic opera, but his roasted meats smell heavenly. Get to work, monsieur!
upgrades.desc: Hire Chef Marcel, an eccentric culinary artisan who dramatically boosts food preparation output.

upgrades.name: Hire Garrett (Bartender)
upgrades.nyahComment: He hasn't smiled once in twenty years. One stare from him and brawl-starters apologize and drink quietly.
upgrades.desc: Hire Garrett, a towering stoic barkeep who dispenses ales and suppresses trouble with absolute calm.

upgrades.name: Hire Pippa (Maid)
upgrades.nyahComment: She bounces on her tiptoes and giggles at everything. It's sickeningly cute, but patrons tip her like crazy.
upgrades.desc: Hire Pippa, an irrepressibly cheerful squirrel-folk maid whose bubbly warmth earns huge gratuities.

upgrades.name: Hire Velvet (Maid)
upgrades.nyahComment: She looks down her nose at everyone like we're dirt under her shoes. Naturally, nobles pay double to be insulted.
upgrades.desc: Hire Velvet, an aristocratic fallen heiress whose haughty elegance fascinates highborn patrons.

upgrades.name: Hire Lyra (Minstrel)
upgrades.nyahComment: Her harp melodies make half the room tear up and the other half buy expensive vintage wine to celebrate. Pure art!
upgrades.desc: Hire Lyra, a renowned elven minstrel whose stirring melodies soothe the crowd and boost tavern patience.

upgrades.name: Hire Soleil (Dancer)
upgrades.nyahComment: Her ribbon spins had three wealthy merchants drop their coin pouches on the floor. Don't look too closely, Master!
upgrades.desc: Hire Soleil, a radiant silk-ribbon dancer whose mesmerizing shows keep patrons drinking and tipping.

upgrades.name: Tabletop Tallow Candles
upgrades.nyahComment: Warm flickers on every table. Try not to singe your apron strings, Master, I won't sew them back.
upgrades.desc: Hand-dipped tallow candles in pressed tin holders casting a warm glow across dinner tables.

upgrades.name: Stone Hearth Logs
upgrades.nyahComment: Crackling birch logs in the corner fireplace. If I curl up right in front of it during break, do NOT bother me.
upgrades.desc: Install cast-iron fire dogs and fragrant slow-cured birch logs in the tavern fireplace.

upgrades.name: Woven Crimson Runner
upgrades.nyahComment: A lovely red wool runner down the aisle. Tell those muddy adventurers to scrape their boots first or else!
upgrades.desc: Durable hand-woven crimson runner quieting muddy boots along the tavern's central aisle.

upgrades.name: Hanging Herb Bundles
upgrades.nyahComment: Bundles of dried lavender, sage, and mint from the rafters. Covers up the musk of sweaty mercenaries nicely.
upgrades.desc: Suspended aromatic herb bouquets drying from timber ceiling rafters, filling the air with pleasant scents.

upgrades.name: Potted Broadleaf Ferns
upgrades.nyahComment: Potted greenery in the dark corners. If anyone dumps leftover ale into the potting soil, they wash dishes all night.
upgrades.desc: Terracotta planters with lush evergreen ferns bringing forest freshness into the hall.

upgrades.name: Guild Crest Banners
upgrades.nyahComment: Gold-fringed silken wall banners. Now we actually look like a legitimate establishment of repute, Master!
upgrades.desc: Rich embroidered fabric banners emblazoned with tavern motifs draped along structural beams.

upgrades.name: Southern Medallion Carpet
upgrades.nyahComment: An opulent central carpet imported from southern oasis markets. Soft enough to nap on... not that I would!
upgrades.desc: Intricately patterned artisan carpet placed under premier central dining tables.

upgrades.name: Gilded Mountain Landscape
upgrades.nyahComment: A majestic oil painting of the snowy peaks. The traveling artist traded it for a month of free stew. Fair deal!
upgrades.desc: Gilded framed oil canvas showcasing the surrounding crags and moonlit pine forests.

upgrades.name: Antique Plate Display
upgrades.nyahComment: A full suit of tournament plate armor by the door. I keep mistaking it for an intruder and hissing at it.
upgrades.desc: Flawlessly polished antique steel suit of armor standing vigilant guard beside the entrance.

upgrades.name: Mounted Wyvern Trophy
upgrades.nyahComment: A stuffed highland wyvern head above the arch! Look at those sharp fangs... almost as intimidating as mine.
upgrades.desc: Dramatically mounted horned wyvern head trophy overlooking the main tavern hall.

upgrades.name: Grand Brass Chandelier
upgrades.nyahComment: A two-tier brass chandelier with forty wax pillars! We look like a royal palace ballroom now, Master!
upgrades.desc: Magnificent wrought brass wheel chandelier illuminating the tavern in radiant golden brilliance.
